existing_display_reference.status: strict decode failed; raw decoded bytes preserved

provenance.existing_display_qualification: Reference only: assumed_code_page 950 if present, not authoritative native decoding. No view created or rewritten.

policy.encoding: bytes authoritative; printable ASCII view only; no codec inference or non-ASCII decode
policy.physical_lines: CRLF, standalone CR, standalone LF only; retain terminator; terminal EOL creates no phantom row
policy.tokens: literal byte 23 (#), retain every empty/trailing token and whitespace; no escape grammar inferred
policy.header: first nonblank physical line, standalone unsigned ASCII decimal after SP/HT trim; observed count declaration only
policy.comment: first non-SP/HT byte is 3B (;); preserve whole content; other semicolons retained without inline truncation
policy.file_key: non-header non-comment hash row, first token SP/HT-trimmed signed ASCII decimal; arbitrary precision; no width coercion
policy.commented_key: separate inactive declaration after exactly one leading comment marker; never active file key
policy.placeholder: token SP/HT-trimmed equals exact lowercase ASCII no exist or no exsist; marker flag, not deleted
policy.label_metadata: all tokens returned with positions and bytes; no canonical title column or fallback key
policy.duplicate_keys: all matching physical rows in source order; no first/last winner

authority_guard: Candidate bytes only. File key, physical line, header count and token position do not qualify runtime table index, locale, label codec or map/resource ID. No cross-candidate alignment or title-column inference.
